name: The Sins That Cry For Vengeance
source:
In 1920s Chicago, violence upends a young woman's life, and she decides to work for her savior, to ruin the criminals that destroyed his life — and hers. When love threatens her with redemption, will she choose forgiveness or revenge?
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_Sins_That_Cry_For_Vengeance]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
